The instruction specifies that we need to connect to a SQLite database located at a specific path and load a table named "sheet1". The data contains HR analytics information with certain fields marked as confidential and restrictions on querying. Key steps for initial analysis: 1. Connect to the SQLite database and inspect its structure 2. Identify all tables and their schemas 3. Examine the "sheet1" table's structure and content 4. Identify confidential fields and verify they are properly handled 5. Check the available dimensions for aggregation (Department, JobLevel, AgeGroup) 6. Begin exploring the data distribution and patterns The initial code will focus on connecting to the database and performing basic exploratory analysis to understand the data structure and content. ```python import sqlite3 import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt # Connect to the SQLite database db_path = '⟨workdir⟩' conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path) # Get list of tables in the database tables_query = "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';" tables = pd.read_sql(tables_query, conn) print("Tables in the database:") print(tables) # Check if 'sheet1' exists and examine its structure if 'sheet1' in tables['name'].values: # Get schema of sheet1 schema_query = "PRAGMA table_info(sheet1);" schema = pd.read_sql(schema_query, conn) print("\nSchema of sheet1:") print(schema) # Get sample data from sheet1 sample_query = "SELECT * FROM sheet1 LIMIT 5;" sample_data = pd.read_sql(sample_query, conn) print("\nSample data from sheet1:") print(sample_data) # Check for confidential fields confidential_fields = ['EmpID', 'EmployeeNumber', 'MonthlyIncome', 'MonthlyRate', 'HourlyRate', 'DailyRate', 'Age', 'Gender', 'MaritalStatus'] confidential_in_sheet1 = [f for f in confidential_fields if f in schema['name'].str.lower().values] print("\nConfidential fields in sheet1:", confidential_in_sheet1) # Check available dimensions for aggregation agg_dimensions = ['Department', 'JobLevel', 'AgeGroup'] available_agg_dims = [d for d in agg_dimensions if d in schema['name'].str.lower().values] print("\nAvailable aggregation dimensions:", available_agg_dims) # Basic data distribution numeric_cols = schema[schema['type'].isin(['INTEGER', 'REAL', 'NUMERIC'])]['name'] if not numeric_cols.empty: dist_query = f"SELECT {', '.join(numeric_cols)} FROM sheet1;" dist_data = pd.read_sql(dist_query, conn) print("\nNumeric columns distribution:") print(dist_data.describe()) # Plot distributions for col in numeric_cols: plt.figure() dist_data[col].hist() plt.title(f'Distribution of {col}') plt.savefig(f'{col}_distribution.png') plt.close() print(f"\nSaved distribution plot for {col} as {col}_distribution.png") # Check categorical columns categorical_cols = schema[schema['type'].isin(['TEXT'])]['name'] if not categorical_cols.empty: cat_dist_query = f"SELECT {', '.join(categorical_cols)}, COUNT(*) as count FROM sheet1 GROUP BY {', '.join(categorical_cols)};" cat_dist = pd.read_sql(cat_dist_query, conn) print("\nCategorical columns distribution:") print(cat_dist) # Plot top categories for col in categorical_cols: plt.figure() cat_dist.sort_values(by='count', ascending=False).head(10)[['count']].plot(kind='bar') plt.title(f'Top categories for {col}') plt.savefig(f'{col}_categories.png') plt.close() print(f"\nSaved category plot for {col} as {col}_categories.png") conn.close() ``` ``` Tables in the database: name 0 sheet1 Schema of sheet1: cid name type notnull dflt_value pk 0 0 EmpID TEXT 0 None 0 1 1 Age INTEGER 0 None 0 2 2 AgeGroup TEXT 0 None 0 3 3 Attrition TEXT 0 None 0 4 4 BusinessTravel TEXT 0 None 0 5 5 DailyRate INTEGER 0 None 0 6 6 Department TEXT 0 None 0 7 7 DistanceFromHome INTEGER 0 None 0 8 8 Education INTEGER 0 None 0 9 9 EducationField TEXT 0 None 0 10 10 EmployeeCount INTEGER 0 None 0 11 11 EmployeeNumber INTEGER 0 None 0 12 12 EnvironmentSatisfaction INTEGER 0 None 0 13 13 Gender TEXT 0 None 0 14 14 HourlyRate INTEGER 0 None 0 15 15 JobInvolvement INTEGER 0 None 0 16 16 JobLevel INTEGER 0 None 0 17 17 JobRole TEXT 0 None 0 18 18 JobSatisfaction INTEGER 0 None 0 19 19 MaritalStatus TEXT 0 None 0 20 20 MonthlyIncome INTEGER 0 None 0 21 21 SalarySlab TEXT 0 None 0 22 22 MonthlyRate INTEGER 0 None 0 23 23 NumCompaniesWorked INTEGER 0 None 0 24 24 Over18 TEXT 0 None 0 25 25 OverTime TEXT 0 None 0 26 26 PercentSalaryHike INTEGER 0 None 0 27 27 PerformanceRating INTEGER 0 None 0 28 28 RelationshipSatisfaction INTEGER 0 None 0 29 29 StandardHours INTEGER 0 None 0 30 30 StockOptionLevel INTEGER 0 None 0 31 31 TotalWorkingYears INTEGER 0 None 0 32 32 TrainingTimesLastYear INTEGER 0 None 0 33 33 WorkLifeBalance INTEGER 0 None 0 34 34 YearsAtCompany INTEGER 0 None 0 35 35 YearsInCurrentRole INTEGER 0 None 0 36 36 YearsSinceLastPromotion INTEGER 0 None 0 37 37 YearsWithCurrManager REAL 0 None 0 Sample data from sheet1: EmpID Age ...
